units.source_text: 此诗尚有童稚之气，母亲看了泪如泉涌，

en.t: This poem still had a childish air, and when her mother read it, tears streamed down like a spring,

units.source_text: 想起这女儿如此命薄，弄得置身无所，实在可怜之极，

en.t: thinking of how ill-fated this daughter was, left with nowhere to turn, and how truly pitiful she was in the extreme,
